name: Sengir's father
description: A small baron who dabbled in black magic and pursued immortality via vampirism; killed by plague rats.

description_citations.text: "Sengir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir's father tries to become an immortal through black magic and vampirism, bringing his son along.
timeline.quote: The baron intended to become an immortal and he had begun the path towards vampirism, bringing with him his son.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Before Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Young Sengir and the orphan Ravi lead plague rats against the baron; the rats kill the boy and the baron, and Sengir revives as a vampire.
timeline.quote: However, he was visibly hurt by the sunlight and receded to a dark corner of the room, hinting at his now complete transformation into a vampire.
